TDS Event System

Unified disturbance specification for time-domain simulation.

Design Philosophy

One primitive handles everything:

  • Branch trips, load changes, setpoint modifications
  • All reduce to FieldModification
  • Single apply! function for all models

No model-specific methods:

  • Adding new models doesn't require new event handlers
  • Uses existing IndexOrder infrastructure

Core Primitive: FieldModification

struct FieldModification <: Disturbance
    time::Float64      # When (seconds)
    model::Symbol      # What model (:Branch, :PQ, :GENCLS, ...)
    key::Tuple         # Which instance (composite key from get_key_name())
    field::Symbol      # Which field (:st, :p, :x, :Vref, ...)
    operation::Symbol  # How (:set, :add, :multiply)
    value::Float64     # Value for operation
end

Operations:

  • :set → field = value
  • :add → field = field + value
  • :multiply → field = field * value

How Keys Work

Each model defines its composite key via get_key_name() trait:

get_key_name(::Type{Bus}) = :i           # (bus_number,)
get_key_name(::Type{PQ}) = [:i, :id]     # (bus_number, load_id)
get_key_name(::Type{Branch}) = [:i, :j, :ckt]  # (from_bus, to_bus, circuit)

Event key must match model's key structure:

# Branch 1-5 circuit "1"
FieldModification(1.0, :Branch, (1, 5, "1"), :st, :set, 0.0)

# PQ load at bus 3, id "1"
FieldModification(5.0, :PQ, (3, "1"), :p, :add, 10.0)

The Single apply! Function

function apply!(sys::SystemModel, mod::FieldModification)
    # Step 1: Look up instance via IndexOrder
    idx = sys.order.indices[mod.model][mod.key]

    # Step 2: Get field array
    field_array = getproperty(sys.models[mod.model], mod.field)

    # Step 3: Apply operation
    current = field_array[idx]
    new_val = if mod.operation == :set
        mod.value
    elseif mod.operation == :add
        current + mod.value
    elseif mod.operation == :multiply
        current * mod.value
    end

    field_array[idx] = new_val
    return true
end

Why this works for ALL models:

  • Uses existing sys.order.indices (no new infrastructure)
  • Uses getproperty for field access (generic)
  • No model-specific code paths

Typed Wrappers

Ergonomic constructors that emit FieldModification:

# These are thin wrappers, not new types
BranchTrip(t, from, to, ckt) =
    FieldModification(t, :Branch, (from, to, ckt), :st, :set, 0.0)

BranchClose(t, from, to, ckt) =
    FieldModification(t, :Branch, (from, to, ckt), :st, :set, 1.0)

Adding new wrappers:

# Future: Load trip
LoadTrip(t, bus, id) =
    FieldModification(t, :PQ, (bus, id), :stat, :set, 0.0)

# Future: Setpoint change
SetpointChange(t, model, key, param, value) =
    FieldModification(t, model, key, param, :set, value)

# Future: Multiple field changes
function LoadChange(t, bus, id; Δp=0.0, Δq=0.0)
    mods = FieldModification[]
    Δp != 0 && push!(mods, FieldModification(t, :PQ, (bus, id), :p, :add, Δp))
    Δq != 0 && push!(mods, FieldModification(t, :PQ, (bus, id), :q, :add, Δq))
    return mods
end

DifferentialEquations.jl Integration

Events become DiscreteCallbacks:

function to_callback(mod::FieldModification, sys::SystemModel, DiffEq)
    condition = (u, t, integrator) -> t >= mod.time
    affect! = (integrator) -> begin
        apply!(sys, mod)
        integrator.u_modified = true  # Trigger Jacobian rebuild
    end
    return DiffEq.DiscreteCallback(condition, affect!)
end

TDS solve() auto-builds callbacks:

function solve(prob::TDSProblem; kwargs...)
    # ...
    if !isempty(prob.events)
        callbacks = build_event_callbacks(prob.events, prob.sys)
    end
    # Pass callbacks to DiffEq.solve()
end

User API

using Powerful, PowerFlowData, DifferentialEquations

# Setup
case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
sys = SystemModel(case)
prob_pf = ACPowerFlowProblem(sys)
sol_pf = solve(prob_pf, NewtonRaphson())
dyr_data = parse_dyr("cases/ieee14.dyr", sys)

# TDS with events
prob = TDSProblem(sys, sol_pf, dyr_data;
    tspan = (0.0, 10.0),
    events = [
        BranchTrip(1.0, 1, 5, "1"),    # Trip at t=1.0s
        BranchClose(2.0, 1, 5, "1"),   # Reconnect at t=2.0s
    ]
)
sol = solve(prob)

Direct FieldModification for anything not wrapped:

events = [
    # Custom: halve a generator's inertia at t=3.0
    FieldModification(3.0, :GENCLS, (101, "1"), :H, :multiply, 0.5),
]

Adding Support for New Models

No code changes needed. New models automatically work if:

  1. Model has get_key_name() trait defined
  2. Model fields are accessible via getproperty
  3. Model is registered in sys.order.indices

All existing models satisfy these requirements.

Architecture Summary

User API                    Core Primitive              Infrastructure
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BranchTrip(1.0, 1, 5, "1")
         │
         ▼
    FieldModification(...)  ──►  apply!(sys, mod)  ──►  sys.order.indices
         │                              │                     │
         │                              │                     ▼
         │                              │              getproperty(model, field)
         │                              │                     │
         ▼                              ▼                     ▼
    to_callback(...)        ◄── integrator.u_modified   field_array[idx] = new
         │
         ▼
    DiscreteCallback
         │
         ▼
    DiffEq.solve(prob; callback=...)

Key insight: Event system reuses existing IndexOrder infrastructure. No new data structures or lookup mechanisms needed.
